It is used in the treatment of psychoses including schizophrenia (p.955). The usual oral dose of penfluridol for the treatment of chronic psychoses is 20 to 60 mg once a week. Doses of up to 250 mg once a week may be required in severe or resistant conditions. Schizophrenia. A systematic review1 concluded that penflu- ridol appears to have a similar efficacy and adverse effects pro- file to other classical antipsychotics used in the treatment of schizophrenia (p.955).
